<!---## Bio-->
### *Welcome!*

I'm a PhD student in Economics at [UC Berkeley](https://www.econ.berkeley.edu/). I'm interested in:

* Economics of Digitization

* Economics of Regulation

* Industrial Organization

* Applied Economic Theory

You can find my research [here](https://haosenhe.github.io/research.html). 

Contact: haosen_he [at] berkeley.edu.

---

### *What's New:*

*July 2026*: I'm presenting at [SAET 2026](https://saet.uiowa.edu/2026-conference/)'s session on the The Economics of Social Media in Rio de Janeiro on July 17, 2026.

*May 2026*: Check out my new [working paper](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6806518) on how to optimally regulate social media platforms.
